name: tag

source.prompt: One hanging retail price tag in thick uncoated light-gray card with punched metal eyelet and short loop of string anchored at top center. Crisp die-cut silhouette and tactile paper fibers, near frontal, slightly tilted. Completely blank, no numerals or text.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
